name: Should I reface my existing kitchen cabinets or replace them entirely?

mainEntity.name: Should I reface my existing kitchen cabinets or replace them entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should choose between cabinet refacing or replacement based on your layout satisfaction and cabinet box structural integrity. Refacing works best if your current cabinet frames are sturdy and you are happy with the existing kitchen footprint, saving both material costs and demolition time. However, if your layout has functional bottlenecks, damaged particleboard, or lacks modern storage like deep drawers, full cabinet replacement is the smarter long-term investment. Replacing cabinets allows you to reconfigure work zones, incorporate custom finish carpentry, and properly reinforce walls for heavy stone countertops without inheriting old structural flaws.
acceptedAnswer.description: Keep your boxes and reface if your layout works well and frames are solid. Replace them completely if you want a new layout, better storage, or if the current framing is worn or damaged.
